title: New Day Notifier
description: This is simple Fabric mod, that shows users that another day has passed (as a Title & Subtitle, with more info), every time a new day starts in the world/server they're playing in.
body:
**⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️**

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

<hr>

**Mod Description**

**New Day Notifier** is a client-sided Minecraft mod for the **Fabric Loader**, that lets users know that another day has passed, in the server or world they are playing in, every time another day passes. The way it shows users that it is a new day, is through a vanilla title/subtitle. The notfication contains how many days the world/server users are in, was up for. Also, a DING sound plays when the title appears. The whole mod is toggleable with this command the mod adds: **/togglenewdaynotification**.

For a visual of this mod, please see this mod's screenshots in the **[Gallery Tab](https://modrinth.com/mod/new-day-notifier/gallery)**.
